title: Mitigating Memorization Where It Happens
abstract: arXiv:2602.08901v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce training sequences verbatim, raising privacy and copyright concerns. Existing mitigation methods apply interventions uniformly, often degrading performance on the majority of tokens that generalize normally. We study a token-level log-likelihood ratio between a target model and a domain-competent reference with lower exposure to the evaluated sequences. Exposure-controlled experiments support its use for localizing positions associated with sequence-level verbatim recall. Across evaluated settings, a minority of positions carries a disproportionate share of the positive signal, motivating selective activation correction. From the ideal memorization reduction objective, we derive a probe--steer framework which decomposes intervention into a probe that detects memorization-relevant activations and a steer that applies targeted correction only when the probe exceeds a threshold. translated_title: 在记忆发生之处缓解记忆化
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）可能会逐字记忆并复现训练序列，这引发了隐私和版权方面的担忧。现有的缓解方法会对所有内容统一施加干预，往往会损害大多数正常泛化的 token 的性能。我们研究了目标模型与一个对被评估序列接触较少、但具备领域能力的参考模型之间的 token 级对数似然比。在控制暴露程度的实验中，该指标被证明可用于定位与序列级逐字复现相关的位置。在所评估的各种设置中，少数位置承载了不成比例的正向信号，这促使我们采用选择性的激活校正方法。基于理想的记忆化削减目标，我们推导出一个“探测—引导”框架，该框架将干预分解为两个部分：一个探测器，用于检测与记忆化相关的激活；一个引导器，仅当探测器的输出超过阈值时才施加有针对性的校正。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个探测—引导框架，利用目标模型与低暴露参考模型之间的 token 级对数似然比精准定位记忆化发生的位置，并仅在这些位置施加有针对性的激活校正，从而在缓解逐字记忆问题的同时避免损害模型的正常泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a probe–steer framework that uses token-level log-likelihood ratios between a target model and a lower-exposure reference to localize where memorization occurs, applying targeted activation correction only at those positions to mitigate verbatim memorization without degrading generalization performance.
